message: No detected input validation: The code accepts the YouTube URL and comment count directly from user input with no validation of URL format, domain, or range/type checks on the number of comments beyond Streamlit's number_input widget.

No detected untrusted source handling: The code fetches comments from YouTube via OAuth credentials but performs no integrity checks (checksums, content verification) on the retrieved data, and the URL supplied by the user is split and used without domain or integrity validation.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label distributions, checks label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The pipeline performs basic text cleaning (stopword removal, HTML stripping, URL filtering) but contains no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or any explicit defense against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The model is loaded from a local file 'fittedWinnerModel' using dill.load with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision before deserialization.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training; the model is simply loaded from a pre-fitted file.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the provided code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any robustness stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being used to protect against metric manipulation; the evaluation uses live-scraped comments fed directly into the loaded model.

No detected input sanitization: The URL and comment count are taken directly from user input via st.text_input and st.number_input with no validation of URL format, domain restriction, or range checks before being passed to the scraper and model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs (e.g., probability bounds, NaN guards, or threshold validation) after calling the loaded dill model for inference.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The model is a classical ML spam classifier (not an LLM), and no prompt-injection filtering, content moderation, or jailbreak detection is present in the pipeline.
